commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+3' Girona take a short corner kick.
90+3' Girona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Girona.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Samu Costa (Mallorca) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
90' Samu Costa (Mallorca) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristhian Stuani trots off the pitch and is replaced by Bojan Miovski (Girona).
86' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
86' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
84' The substitution is prepared. Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergi Darder.
84' Michel has decided to substitute Portu and he is replaced by Yaser Asprilla (Girona).
84' It will be a substitution. Oriol Romeu (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Ivan Martin walks off.
83' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
81' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender.
77' Samu Costa (Mallorca) jumps into a tackle and Mario Melero signals a foul.
76' Daley Blind (Girona) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Dominik Greif with a brilliant diving save!
75' The referee blows his whistle as Samu Costa (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge.
73' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
73' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) replaces Cyle Larin.
72' Substitution. Marc Domenech (Mallorca) replaces Daniel Rodriguez.
71' A pass from Samu Costa (Mallorca) is intercepted by Paulo Gazzaniga and the move breaks down.
69' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) steps up to take the free kick. He attempts to threaten the goal but his powerful shot sails a few metres wide of the right post. What a waste!
68' Portu (Girona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Dominik Greif is alert and denies him.
66' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
61' The game is interrupted as Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is flagged offside.
60' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Takuma Asano (Mallorca) replacing Antonio Sanchez.
60' Substitution. Jose Copete walks off the pitch and Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
59' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
58' Samu Costa (Mallorca) trips an opposition player and Mario Melero signals a foul.
56' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Dominik Greif is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
56' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
54' Mario Melero blows his whistle and it's Cristhian Stuani (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
53' Arnau Martinez (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
50' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Yangel Herrera (Girona), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the top right corner of the net. Now Girona have a corner.
49' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
48' Mario Melero blows his whistle and signals a foul after David Lopez (Girona) brought his opponent down.
48' The attendance is 7721.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Samu Costa (Mallorca) brings an opponent down and Mario Melero interrupts the game.
44' CLOSE! Yangel Herrera (Girona) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
43' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

42' Arnau Martinez (Girona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
42' Arnau Martinez (Girona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
39' Wonderful pass from Portu (Girona) for Cristhian Stuani, but they can't profit from it as Dominik Greif comes off his line to collect.
38' Samu Costa (Mallorca) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
37' A cross from a corner kick by Mallorca is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
34' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
32' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Antonio Raillo (Mallorca), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
31' A short pass finds Viktor Tsygankov (Girona). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
27' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

26' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Paulo Gazzaniga! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
25' An attempted cross from Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is cleared.
25' A pass from Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is intercepted by Paulo Gazzaniga and the move breaks down.
23' Samu Costa (Mallorca) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
23' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' Arthur Melo (Girona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mario Melero blows for a foul.
18' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
15' Portu (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' Foul! Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
13' Dangerous play by Cristhian Stuani (Girona). Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
10' Wow, what an escape. Ivan Martin (Girona) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
8' A long-range effort by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
7' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

4' Yangel Herrera (Girona) was too forceful with his tackle and Mario Melero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
